title: Oneonta City School District
description:
Education - United States of America
Oneonta City School District is dedicated to empowering students with the knowledge, skills, and values necessary for success in a changing world. The district offers a supportive environment where a caring staff encourages personal responsibility, civic participation, and a lifelong love of learning. Their programs and events are designed for students, families, and the community, fostering engagement and educational growth. The district serves the local community, focusing on preparing students for future careers and active citizenship
